source: autonomous backlog consolidation — refresh when JSON/dynamic data source changes
objective: Create a DOM-free refresh orchestration contract over existing DataProvider APIs: invalidate/cache refresh, coalesced concurrent loads, per-collection status/revision, change detection, refreshAll and subscriptions without modifying DataProvider/JsonDataProvider/DataWiz.

coordination.providers: DataProvider and JsonDataProvider remain unchanged; controller consumes getCollection(...,{refresh:true}) and optional clearCache().
coordination.datawiz: DataWiz and DataWiz provenance/join files remain unchanged.
coordination.parallel_agents: New advanced by six commits during the lot; final PR remained limited to three DataRefresh files and was mergeable without rebase.

verification.diff: 5 branch commits / 3 final changed files, all inside reserved file_scope; two extra commits only created then removed a temporary in-scope verification marker

notes: No polling timer or browser event wiring added. External source-watch/polling can call invalidate()/refresh() later.
